_about: Gen-Z phrases dialogue scripts may use (slang.py). Each is written exactly as it is spoken, so the voice and the burned-in captions say the same thing. Slang dates fast: review this list every term. Keep out profanity, anything that mocks a wrong answer, and single letters or words that are also maths names (W, L, mid, ate).
